user.title: Samsung SmartTags Setup
user.description: Visit [SmartThings Find]({url}) and sign in with your Samsung account. Open your browser Developer Tools (F12), open the Application/Storage tab, find the cookies for `smartthingsfind.samsung.com`, and copy the value of the **JSESSIONID** cookie. Treat it like a password and do not share it. Normal setup with only JSESSIONID is recommended. Use Advanced mode only if normal setup fails; Chrome or Edge may provide a more compatible Cookie value than Firefox.

init.description:
Update the Samsung session or region used by the integration. To get a new JSESSIONID, visit [SmartThings Find]({url}), sign in, then copy the JSESSIONID cookie from your browser Developer Tools.

Treat this value like a password and do not share it.
